cells.gaps: Whether Inform'All City was ever deployed is not established: the one source, of March 2023, says it was presented and is to be deployed first in the councils of Yaoundé II and Douala III, both in the two capitals. Where the record is held is not stated. Nothing is dated since, so governance and the last twelve months hold nothing.
cells.note: A platform presented and to be deployed first in two councils is a system being prepared. Stage 3 needs it past its pilot and live in councils outside the capital, and no fact says any council uses it.
